issues.title: Decision on a planning permit application
issues.does: Decides a permit application (granted, refused, or sent back as incomplete) and tells the applicant. A decision is the notice of it and no more. The permission is the applicant's liberty to build that kind of building on that lot, which the planning officer records beside a decision to grant, citing the application: the building inspector reads that record, and fines work that has none.

applicant.description: Who applied: the decision is sent to them.

decision.description: Granted, refused, or sent back as incomplete.

law.description: The law the building would breach, if any.

missing.description: For an incomplete application: what it does not say (lot, structure_type).
